note: Gazetted federal (P) and state (N) holidays transcribed from the official 2026 schedule by the Cabinet, Constitution and Inter-Government Relations Division, Prime Minister's Department. Dates marked subject-to-confirmation follow the lunar calendar and may shift on official announcement. The two replacement days are the nationally published ones; states may gazette additional replacement days during the year.
